shortDescription: Get info about the SentinelOne agent package

options.name: agent_version
options.description: Version of the agent to get info about B(latest) (default) - Latest GA (stable) release for the specified parameters B(latest_ea) - same as latest, but also includes EA packages B(custom) - custom_version is required when agent_versioin is custom

options.name: architecture
options.description: Architecture of the packet Windows: Only B(32_bit) and B(64_bit) are allowed Linux: If not set infos about the 64 bit agent will be retrieved. If set to B(aarch64) infos about the ARM agent will be retrieved

options.name: custom_version
options.description: Explicit version of the agent to get info about Has to be set when agent_version=custom Will be ignored if B(agent_version) is not B(custom)

options.name: packet_format
options.description: The format of the agent package

options.name: site
options.description: Optional name of the site from where the agent package is located If omitted the scope will be on account level

options.name: token
options.description: SentinelOne API auth token to authenticate at the management API
